verdicts.reason: A keeps the original layout and hierarchy intact (badge, jar, headline, copy, CTA all in proportion). Its flaws are wide, inconsistent side margins (about 40px on the left), so the whole block sits inward, and a large empty right half next to the left-aligned copy. B distorts the NEW badge into a squashed flat ellipse and shrinks the hero jar to a tiny thumbnail stranded mid-canvas between the copy and the CTA. That leaves the right side dead and buries the product, so the design loses its key imagery.
